tool.name: Workday Agent System of Record
tool.description: Workday hub to register, govern and measure Workday, customer and partner AI agents alongside people and financial data.
strengths: Agent Gateway supports MCP and A2A
Agent ROI next to HR and finance data
tool.practitionerNote: Fits Workday HCM/Financials customers who want agents measured and permissioned in the same model as the workforce; it is not a general runtime or security layer for agents outside the Workday ecosystem.

dataResidency.detail: GA post mentions support for regional compliance requirements but gives no residency detail for ASOR.

deployment.detail: Delivered as part of the Workday cloud platform.

auditLogging.detail: Records and tracks AI agent interactions under Workday's security model; audit export detail not documented.

soc2.detail: Workday SOC 2 Type II covers Workday Enterprise Products; ASOR is not named explicitly.

iso27001.detail: ISO 27001:2022 scope includes Workday Platform and Product Extensions; ASOR not named explicitly.

iso42001.detail: ISO 42001 scope includes Workday Platform and core applications; ASOR not named explicitly.

euAiAct.detail: Agent management and analytics layer, not itself an AI system placed on the market; HR-use agents it governs may carry their own classification.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Workday SaaS; pricing not published.
